task: Find the shipping cost of a Common medium-sized box in flat-rate shipping and compare it with other parcel services.
final_result_response:
UPS Simple Rate Flat-Rate Shipping - Medium Box:
- Starting at $16.90 (lowest speed; price varies by speed: 5-day, 3-day, 2nd Day, Next-Day)
- Dimensions: 251-650 cubic inches
- Common Box Dimensions: 8x8x8 in, 12x9x6 in, 13x11x2 in (e.g. Shoebox or 3-inch binder)
- Pricing based on packaging + speed, not weight or distance.

Comparison - How UPS Simple Rate Compares to FedEx and USPS (from ups.com):
- Maximum Volume: UPS up to 1,728 cu in vs FedEx up to 1,452 cu in vs USPS up to 1200 cu in
- Shipping Speeds: UPS Within 5 Days / 3 Business Days / Second Day / Next-Day; FedEx Express only (no ground); USPS Priority Mail 1-3 days
- Declared Value: UPS $100, FedEx $100, USPS $50
- Shipping Rates: UPS National Flat Rate, FedEx 3 Zones, USPS National Flat Rate

Source: https://www.ups.com/us/en/support/shipping-support/shipping-costs-rates/flat-rate-shipping
